test_title: PYST 48: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Direction: Choose the sentence with no spelling errors.**

options.text: Such bloms typically don't lead to deaths.
Such blooms typiclly don't leade to deaths.
Such blooms typiclly don't lead to deaths.
Such blooms typically don't lead to deaths.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Such blooms typically don't lead to deaths."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 

 
• The reason option 4 is correct is that it has proper spelling and grammar. 
 
 
• **"Such" **is spelled correctly.
 
• **"Blooms"** is spelled correctly.
 
• **"Typically"** is spelled correctly.
 
• **"Don't"** is the correct contraction for "do not."
 
• **"Lead"** is spelled correctly.
 
• **"To"** is used correctly in the context.
 
• **"Deaths" **is spelled correctly.
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
